# p0_entra_id_staged (Resource)

A staged Microsoft Entra ID installation, for just-in-time access to Entra directory roles and groups.

Staging assigns the service account that P0 signs in to the tenant as. Create P0's caller app registration in the tenant, with a federated identity credential whose subject is `service_account_id`, issuer `https://accounts.google.com` and audience `api://AzureADTokenExchange`, and grant it its Microsoft Graph application permissions. Then complete the install with `p0_entra_id` and the app's client ID.

For the full install steps, see [Microsoft Entra ID](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/directory-integrations/microsoft-entra-id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "p0_entra_id_staged" "example" {
  # Your Microsoft Entra ID tenant (directory) ID.
  tenant_id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
  # AzureCloud (the default) or AzureUSGovernment.
  sovereign_cloud_id = "AzureCloud"
}

# The p0_entra_id example shows the rest of the install: the caller app
# registration, its federated credential and Graph permissions, and
# p0_entra_id.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The Microsoft Entra ID tenant (directory) ID, a UUID.

### Optional

- `sovereign_cloud_id` (String) The Azure cloud the tenant is in: `AzureCloud` (portal.azure.com, the default) or `AzureUSGovernment` (portal.azure.us). P0 fixes it at staging, so a change replaces the install.

### Read-Only

- `service_account_email` (String) The email of the Google service account that P0 signs in to the tenant as.
- `service_account_id` (String) The ID of the Google service account that P0 signs in to the tenant as. Use it as the subject of the caller app's federated identity credential.
- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed
